_icons.{stalk}: Stalk (the Butcher's Stalk track resource; eye icon)
_icons.{shadow}: Shadow token. Printed as the owning Adversary's own icon (Butcher face, Mor'gonnod demon head, Insatiable Horror coil). In a card's cost row it means using the card requires placing/updating your Shadow token; the costs field value 'faceup' means the Butcher's Shadow token is updated face-up

cards.name: Decay
cards.text: Using a Flashlight costs 1 extra {charge} next round

cards.name: Disturbed Presence
cards.text:
If you end your turn within 4 spaces of 1 or more Investigators, you may reduce each of their {lungs} by 1. Losing {lungs} in this way does not incur {wound-facedown}
If you remove 2 or more {lungs} at once, gain 1 {stalk}

cards.name: Escalating Terror
cards.text: The next time you gain 1 or more {stalk} from the Stalk Action, double the amount gained

cards.name: Evil Eye
cards.text:
Place 2 {evil-eye} (Evil Eye) tokens on any General spaces on the main board. If an Investigator Moves onto or ends their turn on an {evil-eye} token, gain 1 {stalk} and remove the token
Remove all {evil-eye} tokens at the beginning of your next turn

cards.name: Sinister Gaze
cards.text:
Give 2 different Investigators 1 of the following Conditions each:
Choking Fear
Darkness

cards.name: Vengeful Darkness
cards.text:
Place a {supply} token on this card for each Flashlight on the board at the beginning of your next turn
{supply} tokens remain on this card and are not lost during Cooldown. Remove 2 {supply} tokens to gain 1 {stalk}

cards.name: Eviscerate
cards.text: When adjacent to an Investigator, give them the Bleeding Condition. If they already have the Bleeding Condition, give them a {wound-faceup} instead

cards.name: Onslaught
Rend
cards.text: When adjacent to an Investigator, draw 3 {wound-faceup}. Give them 1 of the {wound-faceup} and the Mauled Condition, then discard the remaining {wound-faceup}

cards.name: Burning Heart
cards.text:
Starting on your next turn: For each Flashlight on the board at the start of your turn, your Cultists' and Mor'gonnod's {footprint} is increased by 1 this round
This card stays in effect until no Investigators gain {charge} or {lungs} from any source during their turns
If this happens, place this card face-down in your Cooldown 2 area
cards.notes: No cooldown icon printed; the card text itself sends it to Cooldown 2 only when its end condition triggers

cards.name: Cleft Hoof
cards.text:
Flip 1 {wound-faceup} face-down on any Investigator to place 3 {hellfire} (Hellfire) tokens within 5 spaces of Mor'gonnod. The tokens must be on General spaces on the main board
Investigators must take a {wound-faceup} if they Move onto a {hellfire} token. The tokens remain on the board until you use this Ability again to move them
cards.notes: Cost row shows Mor'gonnod's demon-head icon (his Shadow token); interpreted as requiring a Shadow token update since it appears only on position-dependent Abilities

cards.name: Dried Tongue
cards.text: Next round, Bloodletting gives a {wound-faceup} instead of a {wound-facedown}

cards.name: Razor-like Talons
cards.text: When you are adjacent to an Investigator, flip 1 of their {wound-facedown} face-up
cards.notes: Cost row shows Mor'gonnod's demon-head icon (his Shadow token); interpreted as requiring a Shadow token update

cards.name: Severed Ear
cards.text:
Give an adjacent Investigator the Possessed Condition
Only 1 Investigator may be Possessed at a time, but you may move the Condition to a new Investigator if you use this Ability again
You may not use this Ability on the first round
cards.notes: Cost row shows Mor'gonnod's demon-head icon (his Shadow token); interpreted as requiring a Shadow token update

cards.name: Shriveled Hand
cards.text:
Next round, you may take the Bloodletting Action with 2 different Cultists
If you do, remove this card from the game. If you don't, place this card face-down in your Cooldown 1 area
cards.notes: No cooldown icon printed; the card text handles it (removed from game if used, otherwise Cooldown 1)

cards.name: Spiked Vertebrae
cards.text:
Choose 1 Investigator to make a deal with. You may alter any aspect of the game (except the win conditions) as long as the Investigator agrees. You may use this Ability even if you have been Revealed this round
As an example, you could remove a {wound-facedown} from two Investigators in order to give a {wound-faceup} to another Investigator. The Investigator you are dealing with could counter-offer and demand an extra {lungs}, and you can decide to accept or decline
cards.notes: No cooldown icon or cost printed at all. Also unusual: it may be used even while Revealed, overriding the Cult's Revealed card restriction, and it can alter any aspect of the game except win conditions

cards.name: Twisted Horn
cards.notes: Cost row shows Mor'gonnod's demon-head icon (his Shadow token); interpreted as requiring a Shadow token update

cards.name: Unblinking Eye
cards.text: Investigators who do not place a Flashlight next round gain the Paranoid Condition

cards.name: Flagellate
cards.text:
You may move an Investigator that is 2 spaces away from you adjacent to yourself
Additionally, you may give an adjacent Investigator 1 {wound-faceup} and the Bleeding Condition

cards.name: Immolate
cards.text:
Give an adjacent Investigator 2 {wound-faceup}
You may repeat this Attack on a different Investigator once per turn

cards.name: Ravage
cards.text: Give an adjacent Investigator 3 {wound-faceup}

cards.name: Devour
cards.text: On your next turn, instead of Ambushing you may use your Attack card on 1 adjacent Investigator at any point during your turn (updating your {shadow} token if you do), as long as you do not Move onto any Bright spaces before doing so

cards.name: Fuming Fissure
cards.text:
Next round, Investigators inside of Zones lose a {charge} at the end of their turn
Investigators outside of Zones must spend an extra {charge} to use their Flashlight

cards.name: Occluded Lights
cards.text:
Either: give 2 Investigators the Darkness Condition
Or: give 1 Investigator Darkness and place an {occluded-lights} (Occluded Lights) token on any Zone. Bright or Dim tokens may not be placed on this Zone next round
Put this card in front of the Adversary screen when you use it. At the end of the next round, place it face-down in your Cooldown 2 area and remove the {occluded-lights} token (if placed)
cards.notes: No cooldown icon printed; the card text delays its move to Cooldown 2 until the end of the next round

cards.name: Projectile Adhesive
cards.text: Give all Investigators within 5 spaces of you the Gear Jam Condition
cards.notes: Cost row shows the Insatiable Horror's coil icon (its Shadow token); interpreted as requiring a Shadow token update since it appears only on position-dependent Abilities

cards.name: Thick Mucus
cards.text:
Place 2 {mucus} (Mucus) tokens within 5 spaces of you on empty General spaces on the main board
Neither the Investigators nor the Adversary may Move onto these tokens, but they do not block line of sight
Remove the tokens at the end of the next round
cards.notes: Cost row shows the Insatiable Horror's coil icon (its Shadow token); interpreted as requiring a Shadow token update

cards.name: Tunnel
cards.text:
Place 1 {tunnel} (Tunnel) token on any space on the main board. At any point during your next turn, you may Move on or adjacent to the {tunnel} token. You do not need to notify the Investigators if you do
Remove the token at the end of the next round

cards.name: Bufotoxin
cards.text: Give the Investigator 1 {wound-facedown}, the Bufotoxin Condition, and the Mauled Condition

cards.name: Gastric Secretions
cards.text:
Give the Investigator 1 {wound-facedown} and the Mauled Condition
Immediately place 1 {hatchling} (Hatchling) token on an adjacent space on the main board and draw the Hatchling card
You may have a max of 3 Hatchlings at a time

cards.name: Neurotoxin
cards.text: Give the Investigator 1 {wound-facedown}, the Neurotoxin Condition, and the Mauled Condition

cards.name: Enraged
cards.text:
You cannot Ambush and are always Revealed. Your movement speed is 4, Bright spaces cost an extra movement, and you may not roll the Sprint die
Once per turn, you may move any number of Investigators within 2 spaces adjacent to yourself and use your Attack card on them
Adjacent Investigators can take an {involved-action} (Involved Action) to place a {supply} token on the Banish The Horror player aid. When there are 3 {supply} tokens on the player aid, you lose
cards.notes: Not an Attack/Ability card: back reads CONDITION with a pulse icon. Adversary Condition card for the Insatiable Horror; changes core movement/Ambush rules while in effect

cards.name: Hatchling
cards.text:
Each Hatchling may Move up to 4 spaces each round, ignoring Map Hazards
When adjacent to an Investigator, you may flip a {wound-facedown} face-up. If they have no {wound-facedown}, give them one. The same Investigator may not be targeted by the Hatchlings twice in the same turn
When a {hatchling} (Hatchling) token is in a Bright space, an adjacent Investigator may take an {involved-action} (Involved Action) to remove it
cards.notes: Not an Attack/Ability card: back reads HATCHLING. Rules reference drawn when Gastric Secretions creates a Hatchling

cards.name: Revealed
cards.text:
You may not use Stalk or an Attack card
Flip this card face-down if you end your turn Hidden
cards.notes: Not an Attack/Ability card: back reads REVEALED with the Butcher's icon

cards.name: Revealed
cards.text:
Individual Cultists may not use Bloodletting during any turn in which their standee was on the main board. Other Cultists that were not Revealed may still use Bloodletting
Mor'gonnod may not use his Abilities during any turn in which his standee was on the main board
Flip this card face-down if all of your figures end your turn Hidden
cards.notes: Not an Attack/Ability card: back reads REVEALED with the Cult's icon

cards.name: Revealed
cards.text:
You may not use Ambush or an Attack card
Flip this card face-down if you end your turn Hidden
cards.notes: Not an Attack/Ability card: back reads REVEALED with the Insatiable Horror's icon
